attr.title: SunDog: Frozen Legacy
attr.desc: SunDog: Frozen Legacy is FTL Software's 1985 space trading and exploration game, where you take over a starship to build a colony for a religious sect while trading, fighting and running your ship's systems in real time. This port runs the original Atari ST game code through laanwj's p-system interpreter.
attr.inst: Copy your SunDog: Frozen Legacy v3.0 Atari ST disk image (.st or .stx, original disk layout, not the re-packed version) to ports/sundog/. An .stx image is converted automatically on first launch.
